{{Quote|One of the reasons she was a good woman, wife, and mother was because she didn't think about herself first. Not a selfish bone in your mother's body. Everyone else came first and what she wanted was saved for later because we needed her now. And now she has no more later, and there seems little reason in having a later without her|[[Hal Horn]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
'''Nyche''' was the wife of [[Hal Horn]] and the mother of [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]. She died a few months before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] accident.

She preferred the [[ZX-26 airspeeder]]s over the flashier [[ZRX-29 airspeeder]]s.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
